title: Minimum site area of a proposed rear battleaxe lot (Table 2B)
text: C4.1.1 Development which complies with the dwelling type and site area provisions set out in Table 2B and the following provisions. Table 2B Site area requirements, Minimum lot area/rear battleaxe (m2): R2 -; R2.5 -; R5 -; R10 925; R12.5 762.5; R15 655; R17.5 587.5; R20 450; R25 425; R30 410; R35 395; R40 380; R50 160; R60 120; R80 100; R100-SL -. Notes: R80 site area provisions apply to all single houses located on lots coded R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR. - Indicated not applicable. Min. Minimum site area. Av. Average site area.

verified.note: Battleaxe values checked. Whether the C4.1.5 to C4.1.7 reductions of 'the minimum and average site area' reach the battleaxe column is not stated on the page.

notes: Applies where the subdivision creates a battleaxe lot (rule conditions). subdivision.min_battleaxe_site_area_m2 is a proposed fact (smallest proposed battleaxe lot, calculated per C4.1.3). Concessions not applied to the battleaxe column (see C4.1.1-r2).
